# CollectionBuilder source collection

Source repository: `CollectionBuilder/collectionbuilder-csv`

Source branch: `main`

Collected for: LGFC Issue #2878

License: MIT. See `LICENSE` in this directory.

## Collected files

- `nav-search-lunr.html` — accessible collection search form.
- `advanced-search-modal.html` — metadata-field advanced-search interface.

## Intended LGFC use

These source files are preserved as licensed upstream code for direct inspection and controlled adaptation into the LGFC Next.js application. They are not connected to production routes on this branch.

Before integration, convert the Liquid and Bootstrap-specific portions into LGFC React/TypeScript components, retain attribution, test accessibility, and validate compatibility with the existing D1/B2 content model.
